name: Kojima Hiyori
source:
The protagonist's chat friend. She is an innocent young woman who may seem younger at first glance, but is actually a year older than the protagonist. Her innocent conduct has lead to a few lewd situations without her even realizing it. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/tonari/character444.html]Official Site[/url]]
